subject: Redwood: procurement & billing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood: procurement & billing follow-up

Hi Oliver — great speaking earlier today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and a few questions so we can get a clean PO/invoice flow with your AP team:

Recap from our call:
- Use case: clinical decision-support prototypes for pilot clinics (50 concurrent users).
- Target start: mid-April.
- Expected monthly usage: modest to start (~$5k-$10k) with headroom to scale.

Procurement / Billing items we need to confirm:
1) Commercial path: do you intend to purchase via PO (AP) or do you prefer credit card/marketplace (AWS Marketplace)?
2) If PO: what net terms does Acme Health require (Net30, Net45, etc.) and the billing contact & email for AP?
3) Invoice format: do you need a PDF invoice emailed to AP, or do you require EDI/other format? Any specific reference fields required on the invoice (PO number, cost center)?
4) Tax / VAT: please confirm legal entity name, billing address, and any VAT/GST or tax ID we should include.
5) Any procurement docs we should upload (W-9, commercial agreement, insurance certificate)?

I'm attaching our standard invoice template to show the fields we'll populate (redwood-invoice-template.pdf). Once we confirm the PO flow and billing contact, Rachel from billing ops will drop in the sample invoice and next steps.

Next steps I propose:
- You confirm PO vs card, billing contact, net terms, and billing address by EOD Wednesday 3/11
- If PO: share the PO number when available and we’ll link to the order form
- If Marketplace: we can provide guidance for procurement to buy via AWS Marketplace (may affect invoicing/terms)

Thanks — I’ll follow up with Rachel on the internal next steps once you confirm.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(415) 555-9182

Attachment: redwood-invoice-template.pdf

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmehealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood: procurement & billing follow-up

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. Answers below (inline):

> 1) Commercial path: do you intend to purchase via PO (AP) or do you prefer credit card/marketplace (AWS Marketplace)?
We prefer PO through AP for now. Marketplace is something we may evaluate later, but procurement prefers vendor invoices for pilots.

> 2) If PO: what net terms does Acme Health require (Net30, Net45, etc.) and the billing contact & email for AP?
Net30 is standard for us. AP contact: Melissa Ortega <ap@acmehealth.com> (please cc for invoices).

> 3) Invoice format: do you need a PDF invoice emailed to AP, or do you require EDI/other format? Any specific reference fields required on the invoice (PO number, cost center)?
PDF emailed to ap@acmehealth.com is fine. Please include the PO number (we'll provide when PO is issued) and our cost center code: CC-CLIN-07.

> 4) Tax / VAT: please confirm legal entity name, billing address, and any VAT/GST or tax ID we should include.
Legal entity: Acme Health, Inc.
Billing address:
Acme Health, Inc.
Accounts Payable
1234 Healthway Dr
Suite 200
Burlingame, CA 94010
Tax ID / EIN: 12-3456789

> 5) Any procurement docs we should upload (W-9, commercial agreement, insurance certificate)?
Please send a W-9 and our procurement team will run the standard vendor setup. If you have standard MSAs/order forms, that would be helpful.

We can get the PO out once legal has an SOW/order form and the W-9. Let me know if you need anything else to turn this around.

—Oliver
Oliver Grant
Senior Program Manager, Digital Health
oliver.grant@acmehealth.com
(650) 555-1020

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@acmehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood: procurement & billing follow-up

Hi Oliver — thanks for the fast answers and for sharing the AP contact. Looping in Redwood Billing Ops to confirm process and deliverables.

We can absolutely support PO + Net30 and will email invoices to ap@acmehealth.com. For your checklist: 
- We can attach the PO number and cost center on the invoice (we will populate the PO field when provided).
- We’ll provide a PDF invoice via email; if you later need EDI let us know and we can surface options.
- W-9 attached (redwood-sample-invoice.pdf includes a visual example of field placement; redwood-sow.pdf is a sample order form we typically use).

Action items from Redwood side:
1) Marissa will send the formal order form / commercial order for signature (DocuSign link will be provided).
2) Once we receive a PO number from Acme AP, we’ll finalize the first invoice and send to ap@acmehealth.com.
3) For tax/EIN: we’ll include Redwood’s legal name and tax ID on the invoice — Marissa, please confirm exact legal entity for the order form.

If AP needs anything else (certificate of insurance, vendor questionnaire), please let us know the contact and we’ll get those to you.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Billing Operations, Redwood Inference
(rachel.kim@redwood.ai)

Attachments: redwood-sample-invoice.pdf; redwood-sow.pdf

Thanks Oliver — this is perfect. Quick confirmation of next steps so we’re aligned:

- Redwood will send the commercial order form (DocuSign) by EOD today for your legal to review.
- Please ask AP (ap@acmehealth.com) to provide the PO number back to us when it’s ready (we’ll need the number to apply to the invoice).
- Billing ops (Rachel) will generate the PDF invoice with Net30 terms and send to ap@acmehealth.com once PO is submitted.
- We will include the PO field and cost center (CC-CLIN-07) on the invoice, and include Redwood’s legal entity and tax ID on the document.
- W-9 is attached per request. If legal needs any other standard docs (MSA, insurance cert), please route them to me and I’ll have our team respond.

Question for you: would procurement prefer us to set up a Marketplace listing for easier purchases later, or keep purchases direct for now? Either works — just want to flag potential impact on invoicing and terms.

If that timeline works, I’ll mark the deal as procurement-ready and follow up once the PO is posted.

Thanks again — talk soon.
